title: NT-proBNP as a Tool for the Detection of Acute Pulmonary Artery Embolism (APE)
brief_summary: In patients with suspected APE (Acute Pulmonary Embolism) referred to the intensive care unit (ICU)after major surgery, serum NT-proBNP (N-terminal proBNP), Troponin-I and D-dimers were measured according to the standard hospital protocol. To definitively confirm or exclude APE, all patients underwent an angiographic CT-scan of the thorax.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

all patients referred to the ICU with suspected APE

Exclusion Criteria:

none
study_population: Patients after major surgery referred to the anesthesiologic ICU due to suspected acute pulmonary embolism.
condition: Pulmonary Embolism Without Mention of Acute Cor Pulmonale
